title: D7327

page_data.en:
THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY,
（印：No. S. B. L. 7327 / MARCH 21, 1936）

ROUND THE WORLD
ON A BICYCLE
Mr. I. Tass Leaving Shanghai
on Sunday

Many travellers come to Shanghai.
Tourists come by boat but there is the
adventurer, who journeying by car,
quaint craft, or foot is drawn to
an electric light. Though many an
adventurer has passed through, few
have started from this city. There are
exceptions of course and such is Mr.
I. Tass, a Jewish journalist and an
active member of the Shanghai Jewish
Recreation Club, who is leaving
on Sunday.
It is his intention to cycle round the
world visiting strange countries and
seeing their cities. He has set himself
an arduous task and the first part of
his route will be to Java via Hong-
kong, Canton, Macao, Ludjao, Hanoi,
Siam, and Bangkok. He has a fluent
knowledge of English, German, Italian,
and Russian and this should prove of
considerable assistance to him on his
journey.

（手写签名）
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，星期六，
（印：编号 S. B. L. 7327 / 1936年3月21日）

环球骑行
塔斯先生将于周日离沪

许多旅行者来到上海。
游客乘船而来，但也有冒险家，
他们驾车、乘坐奇特的船只或步行，
被电灯所吸引。虽然许多冒险家
途经此地，但从此地出发者寥寥。
当然也有例外，塔斯（I. Tass）先生
便是其中之一。他是一位犹太记者，
也是上海犹太娱乐俱乐部的活跃成员，
将于周日启程。

他计划骑自行车环游世界，走访
陌生的国度，参观那里的城市。
他为自己设定了一项艰巨的任务，
其路线的第一段将是经香港、广州、
澳门、Ludjao（音译）、河内、暹罗
和曼谷前往爪哇。他能流利地使用
英语、德语、意大利语和俄语，这
将在他的旅程中给予他极大的帮助。

（手写签名）
